extracted.intended_audience: Authors (especially corresponding authors) of papers accepted for publication in IMS journals
extracted.subtask_description: Policies and procedural requirements authors must follow after a paper is accepted to an IMS journal, covering copyright transfer, open-access/funder compliance, publication charges, and offprints. Targets corresponding authors and explains what the IMS will require and provide before publication scheduling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright form required before scheduling
rubrics_metrics.description: All authors are required to submit a signed copyright form. The IMS must receive the signed form before the manuscript can be scheduled for publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IMS will contact authors following acceptance regarding copyright transfers. No scheduling for publication until the signed copyright agreement is on file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright transfer / licensing options
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors must complete a copyright transfer or license using one of the available agreements (General Copyright Transfer Agreement; Plan S/UKRI/Wellcome/NIHR Copyright License; US Government Copyright Transfer Agreement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the appropriate agreement based on funder and author status (e.g., US government work). The page lists the specific named forms that the IMS accepts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with Plan S / UKRI / Wellcome / NIHR open-access requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The IMS complies fully with the open access requirements of Plan S, UKRI, Wellcome, and NIHR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where required by the funder, authors retain the right to distribute their author accepted manuscript (AAM), such as via an institutional and/or subject repository (e.g. EuropePMC), under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license for release no later than the date of first online publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access granted if full publication charges paid
rubrics_metrics.description: Open access is granted on any article for which full publication charges are paid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Payment of charges is the mechanism to make an article open access through IMS; authors should use institutional or grant funds where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication charges are voluntary and separate from editorial review
rubrics_metrics.description: Payment of some or all of the estimated publication charges associated with an article is voluntary. The editorial review of articles and the administration of publication charges are separate activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts are reviewed and accepted prior to soliciting publication charges — acceptance is not contingent on payment. IMS encourages use of grant or institutional funds to contribute to publication charges and explains that these funds support IMS journals (keeping subscriptions low and providing some open access).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specified publication charge amounts and partial payment policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication charges are: 1295 USD for articles in any Print/Gated Electronic Access journal; 825 USD for articles appearing in an Open Electronic Access journal; 200 USD for any discussion in any journal. Partial payment (in any amount) of publication charges will be gratefully accepted if full payment is not possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors may pay full or partial amounts; IMS will accept partial payments. There is also a Publication Charges Funding Form referenced on the page to arrange payment or funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corresponding author receives final article PDF; offprints available for purchase
rubrics_metrics.description: Every corresponding author will receive a pdf file via email of the final article. Paper offprints may be purchased by using the IMS offprint purchase web page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IMS supplies a free electronic offprint (PDF) to the corresponding author. Additional physical offprints are available for purchase through the provided vendor link (http://eoc.sheridan.com/IMS/eoc).

rubrics_metrics.name: IMS post-acceptance contact and administrative steps
rubrics_metrics.description: Following the acceptance of papers for publication in IMS journals, the IMS Executive Director will contact authors regarding copyright transfers, page funding and paper offprints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should expect administrative contact after acceptance and be prepared to complete copyright forms, indicate publication charge payment/funding, and decide about offprint purchases.
